$schema_note: The five motion-state poses, v3. Rotation-only: every value is a rotation in DEGREES about the joint hinge axis [1,0,0]; nothing translates except the documented root_offset_m, which is engine-driven root motion (jump height / squat depth), not articulation. UNCHANGED IN VALUE from v2/v2.1 - what changed in v3 is WHERE you apply them: the target nodes are now the jnt_* joints, not the golem_* groups.
v3_change: Apply local_deg to the joints named below (jnt_pelvis, jnt_torso, ...). Because every joint has jointOrient (0,0,0) and a world-aligned frame, a joint's local rx is the same sagittal hinge the v2 numbers always meant - the values transfer with no conversion. VERIFIED: the crouch pose was applied to the v3 joint rig via maya_pose_skeleton and reads correctly (see previews/pose_crouch_side.png); the resulting ankle sits at y 0.831, which minus the documented root_offset_m of -0.52 puts the foot at 0.311 = the rest ankle pivot height, i.e. the feet plant exactly as designed.
how_to_apply: local_deg is the local rotation of each articulation joint relative to its parent. world_deg is the same pose expressed as absolute world-space orientation; for this all-parallel-X rig, world = sum of locals down the chain. The extend pose adds a Z-axis abduction on the arm chain: [rx, 0, rz], with rz mirrored (L negative shown; negate rz for the R side). All other values are L/R symmetric.
sign_convention: positive rotates the segment's lower end backward (-Z). Hip flexion (leg forward) is negative, knee flexion positive, torso forward pitch positive.
relationship_to_takes: These five are POSE TARGETS for the physics-driven jump cycle - the engine drives toward them with forces. They are not clips and are deliberately not baked into the FBX takes. The takes (idle, visor_scan in golem_takes.json) are the creature's autonomous life and layer UNDER physics; these poses are what physics aims at.

rest.note: Exactly the delivered file, untouched. The 35-40 deg knee coil and silverback arm hang are authored into the geometry.

extend.note: shin -38 = the knee's own range edge; legs are anatomically straight. Arm locals about non-parallel axes are approximate - the authoritative arm values are the world_deg triples; mirror rz for the right side.

absorb.fires_on: landing; engine scales depth by impact speed
absorb.note: shin at 52 = deepest knee compression the range allows. This is the full-speed landing; scale locals toward rest for softer impacts.
